rationale: The agent unilaterally canceled order #W3361211 without first confirming with the user, violating the policy requirement to confirm every order-changing action before taking it. The user asked to change the luggage set for a coat, with fallback to return the item, and only cancel the entire order if issues arose. The agent jumped directly to canceling an entire order with reason “no longer needed,” without confirming the target order (there appear to be multiple orders) or attempting the requested change/return flow. Although some user lookup actions were taken, the lack of confirmation before a write and potential incorrect action relative to the user’s goal fail the pass criteria.
